cases.name: Phyllis Hunhoff
cases.about: Family recalled her smile and unwavering compassion, and describe her as a quiet woman with passion for service, deep faith and trust in God.
cases.narrative: Strangulation and stabbed (one wound at least 4 inches deep). Attempts were made to set her body on fire.
